posts.title: Hit Your 1 Rep Max with AI
posts.description: In the gym, your 1 rep max is the most weight you can lift for a single repetition. It’s not about how many reps and sets you can do. It’s about finding the absolute edge of what you’re capable of. Just once, in the moment after you’ve warmed up or just have a day that you’re “feeling it”. That’s what AI gives you for creativity. Without any of the limitations.
